summary.zh: 撰写并维护架构决策记录
summary.en: Write and maintain architecture decision records.

description.zh: 按 ADR 惯例记录关键技术决策的背景、备选项与结论，并让决策历史保持可查。适合选型定案时留痕、回看旧决策的理由，或在团队里建立固定的决策流程。
description.en: Captures the context, options, and outcome of technical decisions in ADR form, and keeps that record readable. Useful when a decision is made, when revisiting old ones, or when setting up a team decision process.
